desc:
HOUNDS OF MARROW COUNTY - ALPHA 1.74, THE ICE AGE UPDATE IS HERE.

Visit the deep regions of the ice age, but be careful, there are dangers beyond your understanding.

A game about hunting in the haunted forest of Marrow County, deep in the Appalachian mountains. Only with a mutt by your side, do you start the journey across the adversity of Marrow County, night doesn’t tax you, like the day does, but be careful, it’s not just animals that are out after dusk. 

Hunt, fish, SURVIVE. 

Added right now:
40+ different dogs, with different personalities and traits to assist you in your struggle in conquering the forest.
40+ Different animals to hunt, skin, sell
15+ Different guns with various playstyles, attachments suited for every player alike. 
GNOMES! Break one, and they remember, they will be relentless, charge you, with all sorts of different weaponry, every gnome is worth 1,400 Marks - a sizable day’s pay.
Your own lodge! Customize it, set it as your waypoint, show off your trophies!
